title: Who are you?
notes: Her, and the ship as it is now. The crew's talk (design/crew/) has described her for
weeks: the ration board with her at the bottom, walking the decks at night, Tren's
list. Nothing here may contradict it.

lines.text: Imogen Titus. Six years in this chair.
A hundred and forty-one crew. A science ship, about Voyager's size.
We were sent to watch this planet and write down what we saw.
I thought it would be the quietest posting of my career.
Stuck, and running. The core's fine. Food is rationed, not short.
Replicator time is on a board in the mess. I'm at the bottom.
The holodeck's rationed too. The crew have opinions about that.
They're good people. They go to work. That's most of it.
She takes a moment over that.
I sleep when the ship does. She doesn't, much.
Ask Counselor Tren and you'll get a longer answer.
